description: Smart-search filters for the Pending Approval tab ONLY. One config file per tab, because oj-sp-smart-search renders a chip for EVERY filter the loaded config declares — suggestion-filters does NOT gate that row. Each `field` IS the endpoint's literal query-param name (see reportCriterion.ENDPOINT_PARAMS); a field that is not a real param yields a chip that filters nothing, because the views ignore unknown params silently. This set is deliberately CURATED, not exhaustive — the endpoint accepts more params than are offered. No Unit Type chip: this grid has no Unit Type column, so filtering on something invisible was misleading. The Yard chip is labelled from the inv-orgs registry because this view returns invOrgId with NO invOrgName — and note roughly half these lines are still unallocated and carry no yard at all, so picking a yard necessarily hides them. Not offered: fromDate/toDate (no date filter type); includeAll — that mode switch disables the view's actionable-status default queue (279 rows becomes 646 across 16 statuses, plus 75 with no status). It is not offered because the Line-Status-Mix donut is hard-filtered to the four actionable statuses, so switching it on made the grid contradict the chart above it. An explicit lineStatus already overrides the default queue server-side, and Equipment History / Rental Requests both expose the full status set. invOrgId is the page's Yard scope and groupBy is an aggregate mode, so neither is a chip.
